vehicleContext.label: Can-Am Ryker 900

linkage.method: Individual carriers, wishbones and swingarm; fixed upper/lower shock mounts with rigid telescoping body/shaft and axial spring deformation.

display.method: Original SIM graphics on supplied fixed screen. Actual game speed/RPM/gear, including reverse. Fresh planar UVs; at most 10Hz changed-value uploads nearby and in view. Not OEM artwork.

suspension.model: SM-3223 Silver (Standard), original approximation. Front carriers retained; rear vertical-raycast linkage approximation unchanged.

ryker.geometry: Original reference-based game approximations; not manufacturer CAD
ryker.physics: Ryker Road v1; Elka uses labeled game-estimated compression damping

products.inspectionMethod: Only seats temporarily removed; original doors hinge open. Complete car visibility restored on exit.
